text: CRITICAL NEW DIAGNOSIS (worker-1 round 2, 2026-09-04): the test harness was built and runs - MeshHarness two-node setup, pin injection via the PRE-EXISTING AnnounceProcessor::pin_for_test(pubkey: PublicKey) at announce.rs:359 (do NOT add another - it derives the IID itself; tests use direct field access root.announces.pin_for_test(...)), link-layer TOFU via sender.send_announce(&signed_announce(&relay_identity, 1), 0) + receiver AnnouncementAccepted, and the DIO packet via rpl_ipv6_packet(source, RPL_ALL_NODES, rpl_code::DIO, body) transmitted with stack.stack.send_ipv6_uncompressed_to(packet, &[]) (send_ipv6 goes through route lookup and fails NoRoute on an unjoined mesh). RESULT: with a VALID vector signature and matching DIO fields, the receiver STILL returns RplRejected - and instrumentation could not be used to localize it (no_std crate: no eprintln; the log facade is optional and not enabled for tests). LEADING HYPOTHESIS: the reject is NOT in verify_dio_root_signature (the vector passes decode+structural in root_sig.rs unit tests) but in DOWNSTREAM DIO processing after Baseline admission - most likely the DODAG version-authorization gate: the hand-built DIO carries no DODAG_VERSION_AUTHORIZATION option (that is b7z9.88.2's producer territory), and receive.rs/process may reject a grounded DIO lacking version authorization before or after the sig gate. IMPLEMENTER OPTIONS: (a) extend the test DIO with a valid DodagVersionAuthorization option (build via the router's own build_authenticated_dio on a provisioned ROOT sender - but then the root's link key differs from the COSE vector key; the receiver pins BOTH: link key via announce, root COSE key via pin_for_test - this is exactly the two-key shape of the real system); (b) trace via a temporary cfg(test) gate outcome accessor instead of log lines; (c) confirm whether Baseline-admitted DIOs are exempt from version-auth (spec question). The test skeleton from this round (three scenarios: valid+replay-reject, expired-Baseline, clockless-Baseline, sharing baseline_fixture(clock: Option<fn() -> u64>)) is preserved in this comment history via git stash/commit 485130ae3a-adjacent work - re-derive from the structure above. Work reverted cleanly; tree at committed state 335a965083+.
